main.description: Removes the link between the calling account and an external funding platform. Deletes the `social.colibri.labeler.attestation` record and negates any badge the link was the basis for. Authorized the same way as `social.colibri.labeler.linkExternalAccount`, so an account can only unlink itself.

unlinked.description: False when there was no link to remove, which is not an error.

negatedLabelVals.description: Badge values revoked as part of unlinking.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A parameter was missing or malformed.
